purpose: Productized control plane for generated artifacts in hermetic Rust cloud-ci. It declares which generated artifacts exist, who owns them, how they materialize, and why generated JSON must be regenerated from source instead of hand-merged.
public_product_contract: Any repository adopting oya-ci can provide this manifest plus an SCM-facts snapshot to the Rust gate. GitHub Actions is a bridge runner; the policy is CI-provider-neutral, hermetic, and suitable for native cloud-ci execution.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: registry-drift regenerates the face from the final candidate tree and byte-compares committed output
artifacts.public_product_contract: A repo-wide accounting projection must be controller-regenerated; humans and agents must not resolve conflicts by editing the JSON.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: registry-drift regenerates the face from the final candidate tree and byte-compares committed output
artifacts.public_product_contract: Cross-artifact agreement data is a generated projection and must be regenerated rather than hand-merged.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: registry-drift regenerates the face from the final candidate tree and byte-compares committed output
artifacts.public_product_contract: Enforcement inventory is generated CI product metadata and must have deterministic final-tree parity.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: registry-drift byte-parity plus baseline ratchet validation; growth requires explicit signoff source
artifacts.public_product_contract: The baseline ratchet is shrink-only generated policy; merge conflict handling must not launder new debt into the baseline.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: The protected-branch push trigger and merge-queue projected-state controller regenerate SCM facts from the accepted final tree; branch-head facts are advisory only for squash-only merge paths.
artifacts.public_product_contract: SCM facts are the single non-hermetic boundary snapshot. Native cloud-ci must materialize them from the accepted final tree, not hand-merge branch-head JSON.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: registry-drift regenerates the face from the final candidate tree and byte-compares committed output
artifacts.public_product_contract: TTL policy is data-derived generated CI policy and must be deterministic across repositories.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: generated artifact controller must regenerate the projection from final candidate sources before merge
artifacts.public_product_contract: Board-sync is a generated planning projection; public adopters must declare equivalent derived planning outputs instead of hand-merging them.

artifacts.final_tree_validation: generated artifact controller must regenerate the projection from final candidate sources before merge
artifacts.public_product_contract: Masterplan projection is generated planning data and must be materialized by a controller, not manually resolved in PR branches.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Project creation
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Scaffold generated-artifact manifest rows, default artifact classes, native cloud-ci runner configuration, and required documentation pointers before the first commit.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: New project templates fail self-check if generated artifacts can appear without a manifest row.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Local authoring
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Editors and local checks can run the same Rust predicate over the manifest and SCM-facts snapshot for fast advisory feedback.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Local findings are advisory only; merge authority remains the hermetic cloud-ci gate.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Pre-commit and pre-push
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Fast checks reject undeclared generated artifacts and normal-source merge policies for generated JSON before a branch reaches CI.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Hooks may block local pushes, but the server-side gate repeats the check and remains authoritative.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Pull request presubmit
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Hermetic Rust gates run over committed manifest plus SCM-facts snapshot and can upload generated diff evidence without requiring hand conflict resolution.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: The single fan-in context oya-ci-required turns red on undeclared generated artifacts or unsafe merge policies.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Merge queue projected state
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: A trusted controller resolves generated-only conflicts by regenerating from the projected source tree and reruns final-tree validation before queue admission.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Source conflicts fail to the fix loop; generated conflict hunks are not accepted as authority.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Postsubmit and main materialization
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Native cloud-ci materializes canonical aggregate artifacts from the accepted tree, records digests, and emits audit telemetry.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Drift on the protected branch creates a repair action and fails closed if the artifact is undeclared.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Release and deployment
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: CD consumes only generated artifacts with declared provenance, owner, source inputs, and final-tree validation evidence.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Release packaging rejects undeclared or drifted generated artifacts.

development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.name: Operations and drift repair
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.automation: Scheduled controllers detect drift, create repair PRs, and report generated artifact metrics by class and materialization mode.
development_lifecycle_enforcement_layers.enforcement: Missing policy rows and failed regeneration remain red until repaired through the same manifest-controlled workflow.

final_tree_materialization.portable_runner_contract: The controller runs after source-tree projection and after protected-branch updates. It regenerates declared artifacts from the accepted tree, records digests, and treats handwritten generated JSON conflict resolution as invalid input.
